```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Load the library
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)

# Function to draw a Venn diagram for upregulated and downregulated genes
plot_venn_contrasts <- function(df, contrast_1, contrast_2) {
  # Filter for upregulated and downregulated genes for each contrast
  contrast_1_down_genes <- rownames(df)[df[[paste0(contrast_1, "_down")]] == -1]
  contrast_1_up_genes <- rownames(df)[df[[paste0(contrast_1, "_up")]] == 1]
  contrast_2_down_genes <- rownames(df)[df[[paste0(contrast_2, "_down")]] == -1]
  contrast_2_up_genes <- rownames(df)[df[[paste0(contrast_2, "_up")]] == 1]
  
  # Create a list of gene sets for the Venn diagram
  # Create a list of gene sets
  gene_sets <- list(
    contrast_1_down_genes,
    contrast_1_up_genes,
    contrast_2_down_genes,
    contrast_2_up_genes
  )
  
  # Set names for the gene sets dynamically
  names(gene_sets) <- c(
    paste0(contrast_1, "_down"),
    paste0(contrast_1, "_up"),
    paste0(contrast_2, "_down"),
    paste0(contrast_2, "_up")
  )
  
  # Generate the Venn diagram
  venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
    x = gene_sets,
    category.names = names(gene_sets),
    filename = NULL,  # Do not save as a file, render in R
    output = TRUE,
    
    # Customizing appearance
    fill = c("#F8766D", "#00BFC4", "#A3A500", "#E76BF3"),
    alpha = 0.5,              # Transparency of the colors
    cex = 1.5,                 # Size of category labels
    fontface = "bold",         # Make the labels bold
    cat.cex = 1.5,             # Size of set labels
  )
  
  # Draw the diagram on the plot device
  grid.newpage()  # Ensure a new page is created for the plot
  grid.draw(venn.plot)
  grid.text(paste ("Differentially explressed genes -", contrast_1, "and", contrast_2, sep = " "), x = 0.5, y = 0.95, gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}
library(UpSetR)
library(grid)

# Function to plot an UpSet plot with dynamic contrasts and a title
plot_upset_contrasts <- function(df, contrast_1, contrast_2, plot_title = "UpSet Plot") {
  # Convert your data into a binary matrix for the UpSet plot
  data_binary <- df
  data_binary[data_binary == -1] <- 1  # Convert -1 to 1 for downregulated genes
  data_binary[data_binary == 0] <- 0   # Keep 0 as it is
  data_binary[data_binary == 1] <- 1   # Keep 1 for upregulated genes
  
  # Dynamically generate column names for the selected contrasts
  sets <- c(
    paste0(contrast_1, "_down"),
    paste0(contrast_1, "_up"),
    paste0(contrast_2, "_down"),
    paste0(contrast_2, "_up")
  )
  
  # Plot the UpSet plot with the specified settings
  upset(
    data_binary, 
    sets = sets, 
    order.by = "freq", 
    main.bar.color = "steelblue", 
    sets.bar.color = "purple",
    mainbar.y.label = "Number of Genes", 
    sets.x.label = "Gene Sets",
    keep.order = TRUE
  )
  
  #grid.text(paste("UpSet Plot -", contrast_1, "and", contrast_2), x = 0.5, y = 0.95, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"))
}


```

```{r}
# Load the library
library(UpSetR)

# Convert your data into a binary matrix for the UpSet plot
data_binary <- df
data_binary[data_binary == -1] <- 1  # Convert -1 to 1 for downregulated genes
data_binary[data_binary == 0] <- 0   # Keep 0 as it is
data_binary[data_binary == 1] <- 1   # Keep 1 for upregulated genes

# Plot an UpSet plot
upset(data_binary, sets = c("res_vem_1.6_down", "res_vem_1.6_up", "untreated_down", "untreated_up"), 
      order.by = "freq", 
      main.bar.color = "steelblue", 
      sets.bar.color = "purple",
      mainbar.y.label = "Number of Genes", sets.x.label = "Gene Sets")

```

```{r}
library(ggvenn)
library(dplyr)



# Filter for upregulated and downregulated genes for each condition
res_vem_1.6_down_genes <- rownames(df)[df$res_vem_1.6_down == -1]
res_vem_1.6_up_genes <- rownames(df)[df$res_vem_1.6_up == 1]
untreated_down_genes <- rownames(df)[df$untreated_down == -1]
untreated_up_genes <- rownames(df)[df$untreated_up == 1]

# Create a list of gene sets for the Venn diagram
gene_sets <- list(
  "res_vem_1.6_down" = res_vem_1.6_down_genes,
  "res_vem_1.6_up" = res_vem_1.6_up_genes,
  "untreated_down" = untreated_down_genes,
  "untreated_up" = untreated_up_genes
)

# Plot Venn diagram using ggvenn
ggvenn(gene_sets, fill_color = c("#F8766D", "#00BFC4", "#A3A500", "#E76BF3")) +
  ggtitle("Venn Diagram of Gene Regulation")
```
